blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino Dy III on Thursday said that the passage of a free financial education bill for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and their families will highlight the importance of saving the money they worked hard for their families throughout the years. The House of Representatives on Tuesday approved on third and final reading House Bill No. 9806 or the proposed Free OFW Financial Education Act. The measure is aimed at promoting continuous free financial literacy for OFWs and their families.
